meta.scope: Philippines Batch 7 — densification pass: fiscal/debt, manufacturing (ASPBI), tourism, banking/financial system, construction, and supporting nodes. Response to user note that earlier batches were running light (~8 nodes).

candidates.title: National Government fiscal operations and budget statistics
candidates.publisher: Department of Budget and Management / Bureau of the Treasury
candidates.description: Official statistics on national government revenues, expenditures, financing and fiscal balance. Core public-finance series used in macro and debt analysis.

candidates.title: National Government outstanding debt statistics
candidates.description: Outstanding domestic and external debt of the national government, with periodic updates on composition and ratios. High-visibility macro-fiscal indicator.

candidates.title: Annual Survey of Philippine Business and Industry – Manufacturing
candidates.description: Detailed structural statistics on manufacturing establishments, employment, revenue and expenses from the ASPBI. Complements the national-accounts manufacturing GVA series.

candidates.title: Tourism statistics (arrivals, receipts, TDGVA)
candidates.description: International visitor arrivals, tourism receipts and Tourism Direct Gross Value Added. Captures both foreign tourists and returning overseas Filipinos (balikbayans).
candidates.notes: Core tourism statistical product. Canada appears among notable source markets.

candidates.title: Philippine financial system resources and structure
candidates.description: Total resources of banks and non-bank financial institutions, with breakdowns by universal/commercial, thrift, digital, rural/cooperative banks and NBFIs. Provides the size and structure of the formal financial system.
candidates.notes: Core financial-system size and structure node.

candidates.title: Construction statistics and GVA
candidates.description: Construction-sector output, employment and related indicators. Important cyclical and investment-related series.
candidates.notes: Construction densification of the industry cluster.

candidates.title: Gross Fixed Capital Formation statistics
candidates.description: Investment-side national-accounts series covering construction, durable equipment and other capital formation. Links fiscal, private investment and growth analysis.

candidates.title: CPI by major commodity group and regional inflation
candidates.description: Detailed CPI breakdowns (food, housing, transport, etc.) and regional inflation rates that complement the headline CPI series.
referenced_by: Headline CPI and BSP inflation targeting

candidates.title: Visayas regional economic profile
candidates.description: System-level view of the Visayas island-group economy, completing the Luzon–Visayas–Mindanao spatial triad.

candidates.title: Philippines fiscal–manufacturing–tourism–finance densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from DBM, BTr, PSA, DOT and BSP sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding national fiscal operations, government debt, manufacturing ASPBI, tourism statistics, financial-system resources, construction, GFCF, detailed CPI and Visayas regional structure into a denser multi-domain layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier macro, regional and external series
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the densification pass.
